HOME SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Milk souring

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior Decoration 2.6 Budgeting 3.0 Clothing and Tex? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior Decoration 2.6 Budgeting 3.0 Clothing and Tex.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior Decoration 2.6 Budgeting 3.0 Clothing and Tex.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior Decoration 2.6 Budgeting 3.0 Clothing and Tex.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior Decoration 2.6 Budgeting 3.0 Clothing and Tex.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Launde? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Launde.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Launde.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Launde.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Launde.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food Preservation? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Food Preservation.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food Preservation.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food Preservation.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food Preservation.

5. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Planning Family Meals? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Planning Family Meals.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Planning Family Meals.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Planning Family Meals.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Planning Family Meals.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Meal Service? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Meal Service.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Meal Service.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Meal Service.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Meal Service.

8. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Glucose and oxygen

9. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

10. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

11. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

12. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. newton (N)
   C. watt (W)
   D. joule (J)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Budgeting 3.0 Clothing and Textiles 3.1 Yarns and Fabrics 3.2 Pattern Blocks and and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Budgeting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Yarns and Fabrics 3.2 Pattern Blocks and Pattern Grading 3.3 Clothing Constructi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Yarns and Fabrics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
